Old Rod.Description: Can catch Pokémon Rookie rank or lower

Good Rod.Description: Can catch Pokémon Advanced rank or lower

Super Rod.Description: Can catch Pokémon of any rank

Navigator’s Tools.Description: Gives +2 Bonus Dice to checks made when navigating or charting

Alchemist’s Tools.Description: Gives +2 Bonus Dice to checks made when crafting Healing Items

Climber’s Tools.Description: Gives +2 Bonus Dice to checks made when climbing

Carpenter’s Tools.Description: Gives +2 Bonus Dice to checks made when woodworking

Chef’s Tools.Description: Gives +2 Bonus Dice to checks made when cooking meals

Smith’s Tools.Description: Gives +2 Bonus Dice to checks made when metalworking

Thief’s Tools.Description: Gives +2 Bonus Dice to checks made when picking locks / checking traps

Poke Ball Crafter’s Tools.Description: Gives +2 Bonus Dice to checks made when crafting Poke Balls

Fishing Rod.Description: A fishing rod to catch Pokémon living underwater. Make sure to get the right bait or they won't bite.
